steps.name: repo-tooling-sync

steps.description: Workspace layering (ADR-0004) and capability boundaries

steps.name: evidence
steps.description: Committed benchmark, disposable, production, migration and web evidence
steps.run: python3 scripts/check-benchmark-evidence.py && python3 scripts/check-disposable-evidence.py && python3 scripts/check-phase5-evidence.py && python3 scripts/check-phase6-evidence.py && python3 scripts/check-production-evidence.py && python3 scripts/check-phase8-evidence.py && python3 scripts/check-phase8-benchmark.py && python3 scripts/check-source-import-evidence.py && python3 scripts/check-source-import-benchmark.py && python3 scripts/check-migration-evidence.py && python3 scripts/check-real-migration-benchmark.py && python3 scripts/check-web-evidence.py

steps.description: Release pipeline and signing contract (scripts/check-release.py)

steps.description: Source-file LOC policy (built-in, scripts/loc-baseline.json, fleet-default preset)

steps.name: nasa
steps.description: NASA/JPL-inspired warning counters never rise (scripts/nasa-baseline.json)

steps.name: fixtures
steps.description: Synthetic fixture provenance and repository secret/production canaries

steps.name: tooling-tests
steps.description: Python unit tests of every repository script (tests/tooling)

steps.name: rust-fmt
steps.description: rustfmt check

steps.name: container-contract
steps.description: Static container contract and both Compose configurations
steps.run: python3 scripts/check-container.py && docker compose config --quiet && IMMICH_RS_API_KEY_PATH=/dev/null docker compose -f compose.yaml -f deploy/compose.production.yaml config --quiet

steps.name: cargo-deny
steps.description: cargo-deny advisories, licenses, bans and sources (deny.toml)

steps.name: audit-lockfiles
steps.description: RustSec audit of every Cargo.lock, warnings denied

ignore.reason: bundled SQLite CVE-2026-119375; immich-rs opens only its own state databases; the fix (rusqlite 0.41) needs the Rust 1.89 toolchain bump (docs/security/advisory-exceptions.md)

steps.name: clippy
steps.description: clippy (pedantic and nursery denied by workspace lints), all targets and features, warnings denied

steps.name: rust-test
steps.description: Workspace tests, all targets

steps.name: rust-doc
steps.description: rustdoc builds for the workspace

steps.name: cli-fail-closed
steps.description: The CLI prints its version and fails closed without a command
steps.run: cargo run --locked -p immich-rs-cli -- --version && if cargo run --locked -p immich-rs-cli; then echo 'CLI unexpectedly accepted a missing command' >&2; exit 1; fi
